# KALENDARZ 1.4.1

Stable packages for **Android ARM64, Linux x86_64, Windows x86_64 and Web**.

## Downloads

- [Android APK](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/releases/download/v1.4.1/KALENDARZ-1.4.1-ANDROID.apk)
- [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/releases/download/v1.4.1/KALENDARZ-1.4.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage)
- [Windows portable EXE](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/releases/download/v1.4.1/KALENDARZ-1.4.1-WINDOWS-x86_64.exe)
- [Production Web ZIP](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/releases/download/v1.4.1/KALENDARZ-1.4.1-WEB.zip)
- [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/vex2137/Kalendarz/releases/download/v1.4.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)

These are the original verified packages, recovered from immutable commits without rebuilding or re-signing. The source tag retains the original 1.4.1 Git history; the publication workflow checks that application source matches `1ea6f9ed19ce08964b72a1723a6a8855d9150757`, allowing only documentation and CI updates.

## Changes

- Restore Android model downloads and GGUF imports, including models outside the built-in catalog. Import validation and runtime compatibility are reported separately.
- Native llama.cpp support, processing-mode selection, truthful backend diagnostics, and safe CPU fallback in Auto mode.
- External read-only GGUF directories on desktop.
- Working diagnostic JSON export and confirmed memory release.
- Preserve calendar data, recurrence, reminders, settings, themes, AI history and installed models on compatible updates.
- Model-free distributions: retain installed models, or download/import a supported model on a new installation.

## Installation and limitations

**Android:** APK version 1.4.1/code 10406 preserves the original Beta 3 / diagnostic certificate and `com.kalendarz.offline.diagnostics` ID. Install over that application without uninstalling or clearing data. This does not replace the separately signed production 1.4.0 installation.

**Linux:** make the AppImage executable. CPU and Vulkan runtimes are included; CUDA is not bundled. **Windows:** the portable EXE is unsigned and was package-verified, not physically executed on Windows in this release environment. **Web:** deploy the ZIP over HTTPS or localhost; no website is automatically published.

The maintainer accepted the core features on a physical POCO X7 Pro. Android Vulkan remains experimental: Mali-G720 detection is confirmed, successful GPU inference is not. Auto retains safe CPU fallback; GPU-only reports failure. Physical RTX 4060, AMD and Intel GPU compatibility is not certified. Further GPU validation is deferred to 1.4.2. No newly fine-tuned model is included.

All four packages are checked against the recorded SHA-256 values. The publication runner downloads and hashes every draft asset before making the release public and Latest.

## Polski

Stabilne paczki dla Androida ARM64, Linuxa x86_64, Windowsa x86_64 i Web. Publikowane są oryginalne, zweryfikowane pliki bez ponownej kompilacji ani podpisywania.

Naprawiono pobieranie modeli i import GGUF na Androidzie, wybór typu obliczeń, eksport JSON diagnostyki i zwalnianie pamięci. Zachowano kalendarz, historię AI, modele i ustawienia. Wagi modeli nie są dołączone do paczek — można użyć istniejących albo pobrać/zaimportować nowy model.

APK aktualizuje linię Beta 3 / diagnostic z tym samym certyfikatem i identyfikatorem, bez odinstalowywania ani czyszczenia danych. Nie zastępuje osobno podpisanej produkcyjnej wersji 1.4.0. Vulkan na POCO pozostaje eksperymentalny, a Auto bezpiecznie korzysta z CPU przy błędzie GPU. Dalszą zgodność GPU przeniesiono do 1.4.2.
